records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Summit Works set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 (2026-07-07), but no invite and no reply to two outreach emails [email:36d362e0], [email:45986cad], no tickets. Silent since day 1 with 8 days left; Starter single-admin accounts rarely self-activate after a week of no activity, though early project creation shows some intent.

draft.subject: Next step for your Summit Works project
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Nice work getting your first project created last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work into that project is usually the quickest way to see it pay off.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your next step with you and answer anything.

Best,
Priya
